taxonomy_note: Workflow routing only. Choose final root-cause taxonomy from supported evidence.

controls.boundary: App Transport Security exceptions and actual TLS client validation
controls.source_trace: Resolve which request uses which TLS policy and whether custom challenge handling changes peer validation independently of ATS.
controls.implementation_branch: ATS exceptions and custom trust callbacks affect different parts of the effective connection policy. Resolve URLSession/web/native library behavior and the production plist. An exception allowing HTTP is not proof a sensitive request uses it, while a custom accept-all trust callback may matter even with apparently strict plist settings.
controls.controlled_verification: Use an owned endpoint and synthetic data on a test device/simulator; compare valid TLS and a mismatched test peer.
controls.false_positive_discriminator: An ATS exception alone is not a demonstrated secret leak or accepted invalid peer; non-applicable network stacks require separate evidence.
controls.remediation_acceptance: Apply the intended peer/transport policy in the actual client and verify legitimate network operations.
